title: CollateralVault / dToken (USDC + wstETH) - receiveFromStrategy and backstop accounting are not unprivileged; live E-U $0
closed_reasons: receiveFromStrategy reverts NotRegisteredStrategy() for any caller not in strategies[]; only the Aave and Morpho strategies are registered.
claim(requestId) pays request.owner and is idempotent; an unknown id reverts RequestNotFound().
dToken is minted/burned 1:1 against measured underlying receipts; there is no share price or first-depositor edge.
backstopDeposit is one-way and excluded from bufferBalance; only GOV_ROLE can release it.
A direct donation raises bufferBalance/totalUnderlying but not liabilities; a depositor only receives their 1:1 claim, and the donation remains in the buffer.
Strategies value only their own scaled shares / shares (donations ignored) and the live Aave aToken + Morpho share values cover liabilities (backingRatio = 1e18).
forceDeallocateMorphoV2 and writeoffStrategyPrincipal are WRITEOFF_ROLE; pause/unpause are GUARDIAN/GOV.

wstETH vault 0x6042755eCCa71A1Be9C7091441ca5bEaA6b520e4: buffer 79.728909592771306519 wstETH, no strategies, totalUnderlying == liabilities, backingRatio 1e18.

Roles: GOV_ROLE 0xa3d046f3c3bdf081f190f6196c94755497891722 (plain EOA) and 0xf27de84f11e089b838769edfcff9872bc45c84fe (contract); GUARDIAN/WRITEOFF/ALLOCATOR/WITHDRAWER/HARVESTER/TREASURY are EIP-7702 smart EOAs 0xc89592b3..., 0xa8331cfa..., 0x34b8edd6...; strategy owner 0xc89592b3..., upgrader 0xf27de84f....
UUPS GOV_ROLE can upgrade both vaults to a drainer -> P risk over the full $844,153.9; not E-U.
Fork PoCs: 1,000 USDC deposit->redeem returns 1,000 USDC (no queue/fee); donation stays in the buffer; backstop deposit does not enter bufferBalance; receiveFromStrategy/claim gates revert.
No pending withdrawals and no stranded funds; all dToken supply is 1:1 redeemable while backingRatio = 1e18.
caveats: Point-in-time snapshot; the vault is UUPS-upgradeable and one GOV holder is a plain EOA.
Strategy valuations are venue-reported (Aave normalized income, Morpho convertToAssets); a venue accounting failure that does not move those views would not be detected until a writeoff.
A material venue loss drives backingRatio < 1 and freezes deposit/redeem/claim (S), it is not an E-U bank run; the 1 USDC backstop is not a repair fund.
Aave/Morpho liquidity shortages can turn immediate redemptions into 3-day queued claims.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from JPYdf: receiveFromStrategy is registered-strategy-only, claim pays the request owner, dToken is 1:1, and the backstop is excluded from redeemable liquidity. The only material exposure is $844k of UUPS GOV upgrade authority (P).
